seo.title: Pump Affinity Law Calculator - Speed/Impeller Change
seo.description: Pump Affinity Law Calculator — Calculate pump performance changes with speed or impeller diameter using affinity laws with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: P₂ = P₁ × (N₂/N₁)³ for variable speed. p1 in kW is converted to W by engine; /1000 returns kW. Power is proportional to speed cubed.

content.introduction: Pump affinity laws predict how changing pump speed or impeller diameter affects flow rate (Q), head (H), and power (P). For variable speed drives (VSD), Q∝N, H∝N², P∝N³ — power reduction is cubic with speed.

example.description: Speed increase 1450→1750 RPM (20.7%): Q=120.7, H=72.7m, P=38.7 kW (cubic relationship).

faq.q: What is the power savings from reducing pump speed?
faq.a: Power is proportional to N³. Reducing speed 20% reduces power by ~49%. This is why VSDs are so effective for energy savings.
Within ±5% for speed changes up to 20-30%. For larger changes or diameter trimming, efficiency changes and accuracy decreases.
